[Session 1:]{.alert} interpreting comparisons across doses as causal effects
required [strong parallel trends]{.alert-blue} --- a substantially stronger
assumption than most researchers realize they are invoking

[This session:]{.alert} can we say anything about whether strong parallel
trends is [plausible]{.alert-blue} in a given application?

* Main idea: use [close comparison groups]{.alert} --- units that ought to
  behave similarly in the absence of treatment
